description: Provider-facing plan-completion verifier submission. Scherzo stamps workspace context after tool capture; agents must submit only semantic verdict fields.

verdict.description: pass when the implementation satisfies the required ExecPlan behavior, otherwise fail.

blocking_findings.description: Concrete missing required behavior or evidence when verdict is fail; empty when verdict is pass.

evidence.description: Evidence inspected for required behavior, tests, validation, and acceptance criteria.

checked_acceptance_criteria.description: Acceptance criteria, milestones, or required plan items checked during verification.

deferred_manual_verification.description: Manual/browser/dogfood checks explicitly deferred until after implementation, PR publication, or operator handoff.
